entries.rationale: R6 is mandatory and explicitly requires required pre-hook failure to stop before leaving plugin artifact durable effects. The current finalize failure path can preserve artifacts written by the failing hook, so the command-level atomicity contract is incomplete.

R6 is mandatory and names prepare's spec source, draft, flow state, issue-log, and plugin artifact surfaces as command-level atomicity boundaries. Moving spec/draft writes ahead of the route-specific durable sequence changes the command behavior beyond the required failure gate and risks writing durable prepare outputs in the wrong phase/root.
